children.name: Central management explanation
children.text: This catalog, account or installation setting belongs to the central Gameplane installation. Server actions use each server’s cluster.

children.name: Gameplane/Page Header
texts: Platform-wide configuration for this Gameplane instance.

children.name: Card Header
texts: Built-in local accounts plus federated identity providers. Changes take effect on save — no restart needed.

children.name: Provider Helper
children.text: At least one identity provider must stay enabled — the last enabled provider can't be turned off.

children.name: Card Header
texts: Read-only snapshot of the identity provider configured via api.oidc.* Helm values at install time. Connection settings are not editable here; role mappings can be overridden below.

children.name: Provider Hint
children.text: Groups claim and default role are seeded from the same Helm values and are not editable here.

children.name: HelmAdminMappingWarning
texts: The group(s) on the Admin row above were mapped to admin via Helm values, not the dashboard, so there is no confirmation step here. Verify they contain only trusted accounts — anyone in them gets full admin access.

children.name: Card Header
texts: Override the Helm-seeded OIDC group mappings per role from here. A change takes effect the next time an affected user logs in — no restart or reinstall needed.

children.name: emptyText
children.text: No groups mapped — nobody signs in as viewer via OIDC.

children.name: saveHelper
children.text: Saved changes take effect on next login for affected users — no restart or reinstall needed.
